answer: Each new agent must stake a bond locked on a public ledge contract, sized to the cost of faking a month of honest work. Sybil adversaries deploying many identities must post that bond per identity, so costs scale linearly while rewards stay shared. Reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations, like rings on a willow, and any identity caught colluding forfeits its bond to the pool. This turns sybil creation from cheap into a losing wager, harder than splitting shale. The Agent0013 deployment anchors trust at HPhDKT2mD4.
